methodology.description: A deliberately fundamentals-only score. No macro overlay, technical analysis, hedge-fund crowding, momentum or analyst price targets are used in the rating. Daily macro/theme and financing-risk observations are shown separately in the metric tiles and do not alter the score.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil

dailyOverlay.note: Integrated refining makes XOM better positioned than pure upstream if the shortage remains concentrated in refined products rather than crude.

metrics: Funding risk: Low · valuation risk: Moderate
holdings.strength: Cash generation and capital returns are the cleanest in the portfolio. Q2 2026 produced $23.6B of operating cash flow and $17.2B of free cash flow, while the share count continues to fall.
holdings.weakness: Still a commodity business. Current earnings are helped by elevated oil and refining conditions, so normalized-cycle returns matter more than a single strong quarter.
holdings.verdict: High-quality cash compounder for an integrated oil major. Valuation is not cheap on trailing earnings, but forward valuation, balance-sheet resilience and shareholder returns keep the fundamentals strong.

holdings.name: CTOS Digital Berhad

dailyOverlay.note: Credit-data demand is mostly insulated from AI capex, El Niño and energy shocks; softer consumer and credit growth are the main macro offsets.

metrics: Funding risk: Low · valuation risk: Moderate
holdings.strength: Recurring credit-data demand, high gross margins, low leverage and strong cash conversion remain attractive. Recent growth is slower than the earlier expansion phase but the underlying economics remain solid.
holdings.weakness: Growth has moderated, the current ratio is below 1 and the dividend payout is high. Regional execution needs to reaccelerate for a higher score.
holdings.verdict: A stronger fundamental proposition around the current valuation than at the old premium multiples. Quality and cash generation are doing more work than narrative.

holdings.name: IOI Properties Group Berhad
holdings.status: Asset value is strong; Q4 reset still needs review

dailyOverlay.note: Potential REIT monetisation can improve capital recycling, but leverage and earnings quality remain the key checks.

metrics: Leverage remains the main quality constraint
Funding risk: High · valuation risk: Moderate
holdings.strength: The asset base is substantial and underlying operating performance improved materially through 9M FY2026. Proposed REIT capital recycling adds a potentially useful balance-sheet lever.
holdings.weakness: Leverage is high and reported earnings are distorted by fair-value and remeasurement gains. The final FY2026 score still needs a full Q4 reset.
holdings.verdict: Fundamentally investable, but not as clean as headline reported profit suggests. Keep the score provisional until the full FY2026 result is incorporated.

holdings.name: YTL Power International Berhad
holdings.status: Great assets; funding and valuation discipline matter

dailyOverlay.note: Power scarcity and time-to-power strengthen the asset thesis, but heavy capex and leverage make cash conversion the decisive test as AI financing scrutiny rises.

metrics: Funding risk: High · valuation risk: High
holdings.strength: Power generation, regulated UK water, telecommunications and a rapidly expanding data-centre platform give YTL Power unusually valuable infrastructure optionality.
holdings.weakness: Capital expenditure is very heavy, free cash flow is negative and leverage is substantial. The valuation already assumes a meaningful data-centre earnings ramp.
holdings.verdict: The asset quality is better than the current cash-flow profile. The holding works if the capex programme converts into durable data-centre and utility earnings rather than a perpetual funding requirement.

holdings.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
holdings.status: Elite franchise, weak current cash economics

dailyOverlay.note: The thesis remains driven by franchise execution and GTA VI rather than Power Stack macro. Consumer softness and discount rates matter at the margin.

metrics: Funding risk: Low-Moderate · valuation risk: High
holdings.strength: Rockstar, 2K and Zynga give Take-Two one of the strongest IP portfolios in gaming. Recurrent consumer spending supplies a large recurring base and GTA VI creates a credible step-change in scale.
holdings.weakness: Current GAAP profitability and cash flow are weak. The valuation relies heavily on future GTA VI monetisation and post-launch execution.
holdings.verdict: Business quality is much stronger than the present financial statements. The holding remains catalyst-driven until the expected GTA VI earnings step-up becomes visible in cash flow.

holdings.name: Tesla
holdings.status: Balance sheet strong; valuation outruns current earnings

dailyOverlay.note: Power scarcity strengthens Megapack and storage while AI-financing and ROI scrutiny increases the evidence threshold for autonomy and humanoid optionality.

metrics: Funding risk: Low · valuation risk: Very High
holdings.strength: The balance sheet is exceptionally strong and the energy-storage business is scaling rapidly. Tesla still has strategic optionality in autonomy, software, robotics and energy.
holdings.weakness: The core auto business has low current margins relative to valuation, while the market price capitalises a large amount of AI and autonomy success before it is visible in earnings.
holdings.verdict: Financially solvent and strategically interesting, but fundamentally expensive. Valuation remains the dominant drag until optionality monetises.

holdings.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad
holdings.status: Income support remains; earnings momentum has deteriorated sharply

dailyOverlay.note: Offshore maintenance and vessel exposure still benefits from a firm regional energy-services cycle, but the latest earnings contraction outweighs the theme tailwind for now.

metrics: Funding risk: Low-Moderate · valuation risk: Moderate
holdings.strength: The balance sheet is materially healthier than during earlier cycle stress, the company retains offshore maintenance and OSV exposure, and dividends provide real cash return while the position waits for operating recovery.
holdings.weakness: The latest quarter showed a severe year-on-year revenue and profit contraction. Earnings momentum is currently moving the wrong way and the share price has already broken the prior RM1.55 support area.
holdings.verdict: Keep as an existing holding, but do not treat the lower price as automatic value. No averaging down until operating results stabilise or the market clearly reclaims the broken support structure.
